holdout_protocol.outer_spatial_cv: Strict Leave-One-Quadrant-Out (LOQO): for test quadrant q in {NW, NE, SW, SE}, HistGradientBoosting classifiers train ONLY on footprint pixels with quad != q, using only fold['visible'] (global hidden components + 3 px buffer removed) and nested cross-component va/vb elastic splits so no visible fault pixel scores its own trace.
holdout_protocol.metric: Pooled 300 m triangular-kernel Tversky DTI (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8), 200-px (20 km) physical-block paired bootstrap, 1000 draws, seed=520810
holdout_protocol.read_only_diagnostic: SGMC-PROXY-DTI (62,122 off-catalogue USGS SGMC fault pixels >3.0 px from known_faults.tif, 200-px block bootstrap, 1000 draws) evaluated strictly post-hoc on the already-frozen full-map emission (never used in training, feature engineering, arm selection, or budget picking).

budget_and_emission.ranking_variable: vendor/gems57/emit.py::expected_credit(S) = S (*) K_300m for E1 and E2; raw pixel probability S for ablation E3
